title: Stadtwerk Mauer Municipality Public-Context Scope Readiness seed

sourceHints.description: Complete municipality postalCodes[] scope and derived municipal-value context; source hint only, not invoked by this seed.
MaStR/public-context overlay rows including known address.state / mastrId gaps; source hint only.
Cross-brick data-quality summary used only as freshness/provenance metadata.
Bounded-call observability snapshot used only to explain a degraded/missing evidence marker.
AGS/postalCodes[] municipality identity lookup; referenced as a provenance/follow-up source hint only, never executed by this seed.
Read-only OSM land-use evidence for qualifying the heuristic municipal load split; referenced as a provenance/follow-up source hint only, never executed by this seed.
Paginated read-only market-actor directory; a hit is metadata-only and must never be read as proof that the actor serves or owns the selected municipality.

sourceHintsNote: The dashboard catalog remains the preferred Workbench composition layer. municipality.lookup, OSM land use and market-actor directory are source hints for provenance/follow-up only in this seed; the seed must not execute them.
rundeckBoundary: No execution in this seed; any future verify operation remains behind /api/operations-runbook/**.

demoTenant.description: Virtual Stadtwerk Mauer demo tenant; municipality case id, role mapping, review owner, evidence gaps and next-gate labels are invented review data. A degraded or missing public-context evidence marker is missing evidence/clarification only and must never be silently upgraded into a fact, and a market-actor directory hit must never be treated as proof that the actor serves or owns the selected municipality.

roleQuestion.question: Is the selected municipality scope unambiguous (AGS plus complete PLZ set), which context is public versus derived/heuristic, which provenance or freshness evidence is missing, and what safe review gate follows?
roleQuestion.safeNextAction: Refresh/verify existing read-only context only. No public-data correction, tenant mutation, market-actor binding or operational decision.

publicContextLayer.description: Municipality identity/AGS/PLZ context, MaStR/OSM context and any market-actor directory facts; read-only and never removed by demo reset/delete jobs.

syntheticTenantSeed.description: Invented Stadtwerk-Mauer case id, role mapping, review owner, evidence gaps and next-gate labels.

syntheticDemoRule: No synthetic ID may claim to be a real customer, MaLo/MeLo, meter, consent, contract, market-partner assignment, device-control or billing/settlement record. A market-actor directory hit must not be treated as proof that the actor serves or owns the selected municipality.

roles.responsibility: Owns whether municipality identity, AGS and complete postalCodes[] scope evidence is sufficiently identified before any public-context review.
Owns whether MaStR/OSM public-context evidence is correctly classified as public versus derived/heuristic before review.
Owns the derived-evidence assessment and the final review-readiness gate, including the explicit no-call boundary.
Verifies the Blueprint-Pack seed, matrix sync, no-call boundary and source-hint metadata without creating runtime records.
Contributes municipality identity, AGS and postal-code scope context without calling external connectors.
Contributes MaStR/OSM public-context classification and freshness context without asserting a confirmed assignment.
Contributes derived load-split and land-use evidence without upgrading heuristic evidence into a fact.
Receives scope-readiness and missing-evidence status without approving any operational, public-data-correction or market-actor decision.

evidenceRequirements.enablesDossierAddition: Adds the municipality identity row before any public-context review.
Enables an unambiguous municipality scope label once AGS evidence is present.
Enables a complete multi-PLZ scope summary, not just the first postal code.
Adds the checked-source snapshot reference used for the municipality identity/scope row.
Adds read-only MaStR public-context evidence, including known address.state / mastrId gaps, without asserting a confirmed assignment.
Adds read-only OSM land-use public-context evidence for the municipal load split.
Enables a timestamped public-context review status once source-freshness evidence is present.
Enables explicit public-vs-synthetic provenance rows so public context is never silently upgraded into tenant master data.
Adds the derived municipal load-split methodology reference as heuristic evidence, never a guaranteed fact.
Enables replacing or qualifying a heuristic sector split once OSM land-use evidence is present.
Adds the explicit heuristic-vs-official boundary marker so derived evidence is never silently upgraded into a fact.
Adds the explicit list of missing or degraded derived-evidence items instead of a silent gap.
Enables the next human municipal-context review gate once review-readiness evidence is present.
Adds the explicit safe next action (refresh/verify existing read-only context only) as read-only status.
Adds the explicit no-retry/no-call boundary as read-only status, not as an operational or market-actor decision.
Adds the Blueprint-Pack/Landing-Registry/Produktivseite downstream handoff status as read-only pending evidence.

positiveFollowUpMapping.enablesDossierAddition: agsEvidence enables an unambiguous municipality scope label.
postalCodeScopeEvidence enables a complete multi-PLZ scope summary.
sourceFreshnessEvidence enables a timestamped public-context review status.
landUseEvidence enables replacing/qualifying a heuristic sector split.

downstreamHandoff.acceptanceNote: Blueprint-Pack/Cernion-Energy-Tools -> Landing-Registry -> Produktivseite: only the Blueprint-Pack leg may be marked complete by this issue; downstream legs remain pending until separately proven.

rows.enablesDossierAddition: Adds the municipality identity row and the complete postalCodes[] scope list, not just the first PLZ, before any public-context review.
Adds read-only MaStR/OSM public-context classification and freshness evidence with an explicit public-vs-synthetic boundary.
Adds the derived load-split and OSM land-use evidence as an explicitly heuristic marker, never an official or decision-ready fact.
Adds the review-readiness status, the explicit no-retry/no-call boundary and the pending downstream Landing-Registry/Produktivseite sync state as read-only dossier evidence only.

allowedCommandHints.description: References the existing read-only, timeout-bounded dashboard brick; this seed must not invoke connectors, retry a bounded upstream call or mutate public-context state.
References the read-only MaStR overlay, OSM land-use and market-actor directory bricks as provenance/follow-up source hints only; this seed must not execute them.
